parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ locationId: $json.settings.ghl_location_id, phone: $json.caller_phone, name: $json.caller_name || undefined, source: 'end-of-call', tags: [$json.settings.tag_new_call, $json.settings.tag_text_back, $json.source_provider].filter(Boolean) }) }}

parameters.content:
## End of Call to CRM (no duplicates)
Built by Bobby Ve, No BS AI.

1. Edit the **Settings** node.
2. Add a Header Auth credential to **Upsert GHL Contact**. Name: Authorization. Value: Bearer YOUR_GHL_TOKEN.
3. Turn the workflow on. Copy the Production URL from **End of Call**.
4. Paste that URL into Vapi as the assistant server URL (end-of-call-report), or into Twilio's status/hangup callback.

The webhook answers 200 right away. A second event with the same call ID does not create another contact.
